registration_note: Actual availability starts at repository commit time, not this declared wall-clock timestamp.
signal_definition: Only explicitly verified visible green buy marker on a closed bar; six numeric Green_dot series alone do not establish a new buy signal. Archive four points retained as observed indicator episodes, not four independent trades.
forward_activation: first eligible bar opening strictly after registration commit; signal must be recorded by close+15min, otherwise MISSED_OBSERVATION_NO_RETRO_FILL
market: OKX USDT perpetual for indicator parity; no spot substitution

rules.entry: first 1-minute open strictly after recorded observation timestamp; never signal-bar historical close

execution_costs.funding: actual signed cashflows if position spans funding; missing => net_result_unavailable

rules.outcomes: TARGET_FIRST, STOP_FIRST, TIMEOUT, AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR, PENDING, DATA_GAP
rules.same_bar: resolve with 1m; unresolved mark ambiguous and report conservative stop-first separately
rules.dedup: one active episode per asset/timeframe until primary horizon; 4H and 1D correlated, not independent votes
rules.prohibition: No threshold optimization after outcomes; rule changes require new version.
